contentHtml:
Training

At Computer Repairs Stretton, we value your technology investment and we want you to make the most out of your time and resources. Not having the correct knowledge and lack of training causes frustration and decreased productivity not only for staffs and small businesses but also for common residents.

Most users find themselves wanting to adapt and use technology to make their lives much easier and automated but do not know how where to start. If you wanted to learn anything about your computer or anything related to technology, Computer Repairs Stretton is always here to serve you. We can teach you from the most basic up to the more advanced training for any of your computer and technology related learning needs.

You wanted to know how to use and setup your personal email? You wanted to learn the advance tools for creating a financial spreadsheet? Wishing to switch from Windows to Apple without all the complications? You wish to prepare or gain advantage on computer literacy and job opportunities? Or you just wish to have a training about basic maintenance for your own computer. Call us at 0477 319 160 and our expert professionals will have you scheduled for a one-on-one training. Our workshop is open 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays. We serve the whole part of Stretton and all other nearby Brisbane suburbs. We can also send an expert to your own workplace so you can be trained in the convenience of your own home. Our services are absolutely free from any call out fees and travel costs.

On-demand computer training Stretton courses

We offer a wide variety of training courses on both hardware or software learning for clients of all age. Some of our training courses are categorized into basic, intermediate and advanced learning to effectively cover your specific needs.

  • Microsoft Windows
  • Microsoft Word
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft Power Point
  • Microsoft Outlook
  • Microsoft Visio
  • Microsoft Project
  • Internet browsing
  • Basic computer maintenance
  • Email functionalities

Our trainers are highly experienced in all topics about computer systems and software. We specialize in conducting training and tutorials as quickly as one to two days, which might take you months when learning without assistance. Our service has certified expertise that offers professional and customized solution to maximize your skills and make the most out of your technology investment.
